title: Anyone read books while they’re in Mall World?
content: I realized when I woke up this morning that probably one out of every five nights I’m putting away a book or two per night while I’m in Mall World. And I can’t remember a thing about them upon waking beyond general theme (like, last night was a dark Victorian fiction series), but I know they’re not books that exist irl. Most are fiction. I usually get them from private libraries, like the mansion, or my “grandparents house,” I’ve been to the university library/bookshop, but I don’t remember doing more than reading cover blurbs there. And I *can* remember the books I read in more detail night to night when I’m dreaming.
